entities.summary: The Licentiate in Theology or Licence in Theology is a non-degree qualification in theology awarded by some Anglican institutions in Canada and previously awarded in other Commonwealth countries. The qualification was introduced in the first half of the 19th century for candidates to the Anglican priesthood in the United Kingdom and has primarily been offered by Anglican theological colleges and universities.
